page_title: ALA 1-0 VIL | Alaves v Villarreal 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+17' That's the end of the match.
90+15' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post.

90+13' Close! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
90+12' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+11' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
90+10' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+9' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
90+7' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
90+6' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alex Baena will be replaced by Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) will replace Willy Kambwala.
90+5' The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
90+4' He’s off! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets his marching orders from referee Miguel Ortiz after the VAR review.

90+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antonio Blanco (Alaves), but referee Miguel Ortiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+2' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is given a yellow card.
90+1' Adrian Rodriguez (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+1' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 15 min. of added time.
88' A substitution has been made. Manu Sanchez goes off and Moussa Diarra (Alaves) comes on.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kike Garcia as he is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
85' Marcelino has decided to substitute Yeremy Pino and he is replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
84' Villarreal are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
83' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 10:11.
79' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
73' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
71' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) replacing Sergi Cardona.
71' Substitution. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) replaces Pape Gueye.
70' Caution goes to Yeremy Pino (Villarreal).
69' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

67' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Facundo Garces (Alaves) is replacing Carlos Martin.
67' Substitution. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) on for Joan Jordan.
63' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
59' Eduardo Coudet makes a tactical change due to a red card. Adrian Rodriguez (Alaves) comes on in place of Pau Cabanes.
58' RED card! Antonio Sivera (Alaves) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

58' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antonio Sivera (Alaves), but referee Miguel Ortiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
51' The game is interrupted. Antonio Sivera (Alaves) suffers a horrific injury!
49' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
47' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Juan Foyth (Villarreal), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Villarreal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
43' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
38' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.

37' What an opportunity! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
36' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
34' Fouls committed – 2:6.
33' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle after Logan Costa (Villarreal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
31' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
24' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball has crossed the sideline. Villarreal are taking a throw-in.
23' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
17' None of the Villarreal players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
17' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Villarreal earn a corner.
16' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
16' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
15' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Manu Sanchez (Alaves) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
5' Carlos Martin (Alaves) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
5' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
4' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
3' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner with a short pass.
1' The match has just started.
